verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented official client SDKs or language drivers. The closest evidence is chDB, an in-process ClickHouse engine for data-intensive applications that implies an embeddable library, plus a published OpenAPI spec that could support building against or generating clients. The CLI and MCP server are separate interfaces, not SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit official SDKs/client libraries per language, SDK documentation and supported languages, generated-client evidence from the OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
